title: Moving Block Bootstrap Implementation & Centered Null Audit
missing_class_support_policy: Each replicate must contain positive support (N*(c) > 0) for all three classes c in {-1, 0, 1}. Replicates are never silently discarded or resampled via fallback. Across all 440,000 evaluated replicates (11 instruments x 4 block lengths x 10,000 resamples), minimum resampled class support was strictly positive (>= 6,692 for long-history pairs and >= 1,398 for XMRUSDT), with zero missing-class replicates.
